ModMetaData.name: CE + Simple Sidearms Rearm
ModMetaData.author: redfoxdance1
ModMetaData.description:
Compatibility and loadout arbitration for Combat Extended + Simple Sidearms.
- CE is authoritative for quantities of exact weapon defs in a CE loadout. - Simple Sidearms remains responsible for weapon selection. - Duplicate SS memory for CE-managed weapon defs is reconciled. - Manually remembered SS sidearms are protected from CE's undefined-item cleanup. - Adds a bounded Rearm command with one final missing-loadout report.
